hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const i=JSON.parse(d);const p=i.tool_input?.file_path||'';if(/\/manim\//.test(p)&&!/\/manimgen\//.test(p)){console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: manim/ is the read-only ManimGL install \u2014 edit manimgen/ instead');process.exit(2)}process.exit(0)})"
hooks.description: Protect the read-only manim/ ManimGL install from edits

hooks.command: for f in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do case "$f" in *.py) ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; ruff check --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; if ! python3 -m py_compile "$f" 2>/tmp/manimgen_pycompile_err; then echo "[Hook] SYNTAX ERROR in $f:"; cat /tmp/manimgen_pycompile_err; fi; if ! ruff check "$f" >/tmp/manimgen_ruff_err 2>&1; then echo "[Hook] ruff still reports issues in $f after autofix:"; cat /tmp/manimgen_ruff_err; fi;; esac; done
hooks.description: Auto-format/fix edited Python files, then loudly report any remaining syntax errors or unfixable lint issues

hooks.command: echo '[Hook] Work unit done. Before considering this finished, run /python-review on the changed Python files for a deep agent review (the per-edit hook only catches syntax + lint, not logic/design).'
hooks.description: Remind to run the deep python-reviewer agent at the end of a work unit
